Hi Tessa / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. LedgerAI's procurement team asked for a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that focuses only on performance acceptance: latency & throughput, TTFT (time-to-first-token), and sustained QPS with a clear unit-econ estimate.

High-level asks from my side:
- Target TTFT <= 120 ms for 99th pct on a 2k prompt baseline
- Sustained QPS of 250 concurrent c/s for our peak window
- Tokens/sec and tokens-per-second-per-GPU for your chosen config
- Unit economics: $/1k tokens and $/hour for reserved capacity given our expected 50M tokens/month

We'd like the MAP to include: evaluation steps, test datasets (sample prompts), acceptance criteria, timeline to close (we're budgeting for September), and owners. Can you send a playbook + a short run of results (even a smoke run) so procurement can see numbers?

Sarah

Sarah — thanks, and noted. Internal team: looping Neha for the test config and Diego to run the initial load. Below is a concise MAP we propose (high level) — I'll attach a formatted MAP_v2.1.pdf in the next email.

Proposed MAP (summary)
- Objective: Validate TTFT and sustained throughput for a 2k token prompt mix and estimate unit economics for 50M tokens/month.
- Evaluation window: 48-hour directed test + 72-hour sustained soak for the final validation.
- Metrics to capture: TTFT(50/95/99), per-request latency distribution, tokens/sec, sustained QPS (1m / 5m windows), GPU tokens/sec, failure/error rate, cost per 1k tokens (hosted) and cost per reserved GPU-hour.
- Acceptance criteria (procurement-friendly):
  * TTFT 99th <= 120 ms
  * Sustained QPS >= 240 (measured over 30m windows)
  * Error rate < 0.5% during soak
  * Unit econ <= $0.18 / 1k tokens (hosted target) OR committed reserved capacity economics not to exceed $X/hour (we'll provide the committed offer).
- Owners & timeline:
  * Redwood tech lead (Neha) — test configuration and infra — due 2026-08-28
  * Redwood bench lead (Diego) — run smoke + full soak — smoke by 2026-08-30, soak complete by 2026-09-02
  * Redwood AE (Tessa) — MAP coordination, pricing, contract handoff — finalize by 2026-09-07
  * LedgerAI (Sarah + Finance) — test sign-off + procurement approval — review by 2026-09-10

Next step: Neha will add the run configuration (batch size, kv-cache, quantization, GPU type) and Diego will share smoke-run numbers.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & Playbook: TTFT-ledger throughput benchmark + close timeline

Quick tech notes / proposed test config:
- Model variant: rwd-3b-int8 (closest to Ledger's accuracy target)
- Hardware: 4x A100-40GB per pool (we'll provide a Dedicated test pool for the soak)
- Quantization: 8-bit mixed quant path; kv-cache in memory; compiled kernels tuned for 2k seq.
- Concurrency plan: run incremental concurrency steps {50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300} with 10m steady at each step, then 72-hour soak at the target concurrency (250) with traffic shaping to simulate burst windows.
- Batching: dynamic batching with 200ms cap to meet latency SLO, and target batch sizes based on observed prompt length.
- Measurement hooks: redistribute traces to Redwood Console for per-token metering; record TTFT at 1/50/95/99 and tokens/sec aggregated by GPU and by request.

Acceptance thresholds (technical):
- TTFT p99 <= 120ms
- Median tokens/sec per GPU >= 120k (observed per-GPU throughput goal)
- Sustained QPS for ensemble >= 240 qps across the pool

Attachments: I'll push the run config and bench script in the shared Drive link. Diego: can you run a smoketest today (small run) and attach results?

-Neha
Principal Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & Playbook: TTFT-ledger throughput benchmark + close timeline

Running the smoke run now — attaching preliminary artifacts. Summary below (smoke run on 4x A100-40GB, rwd-3b-int8, 2k avg prompt):

Prelim smoke-run summary (single-run snapshot)
- 1-min median TTFT: 78 ms
- TTFT p95: 105 ms; p99: 128 ms (note p99 slightly above target in this short run)
- Peak sustained QPS observed (1m window): 262 qps
- Avg tokens/sec (pool): 470k tokens/sec during 1m peak
- Per-GPU tokens/sec median: 117k tokens/sec
- Error rate: 0.3% (mostly transient rate limit backoffs during burst ramp)

Unit economics (hosted pricing equivalence estimated)
- Measured avg tokens per request: 1.9k
- Estimated token consumption for 50M tokens/month: baseline hosted cost approx $8,800/month (~$0.176 / 1k tokens)
- Equivalent reserved-capacity estimate: 4x A100 reserved pool at expected utilization would be ~$7,200 / month (includes pooling overheads) — final committed pricing TBD with finance.

Attachments included: ledger_benchmark_results.csv (raw metrics), sustained_qps_graph.png (ramp + soak preview).

Caveats: the p99 will likely improve in the 72-hour soak after we tune dynamic batching caps and KV pre-warming; also we need to re-run with the exact production prompt mix Ledger provided for the final validation.

Will run the full soak starting 2026-08-31 and update by 2026-09-02.

-Diego
Perf Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick status and the close playbook below (condensed for procurement):

Closed playbook (one-page summary)
- Final validation: 72-hour soak completed 2026-09-02, run config: rwd-3b-int8, 4x A100-40GB, target concurrency 250, traffic shape per MAP.
- Soak results (aggregated):
  * TTFT p50: 72 ms, p95: 102 ms, p99: 115 ms (meets TTFT p99 <= 120 ms)
  * Sustained QPS (30m rolling): median 248 qps, 95th percentile 263 qps (meets sustained QPS >= 240 requirement)
  * Avg tokens/sec pool: 452k tokens/sec over soak window
  * Per-GPU median tokens/sec: 113k
  * Error rate: 0.2%
- Unit economics (finalized for MAP attachment):
  * Hosted estimate: $0.172 / 1k tokens (based on observed throughput + average prompt size)
  * Reserved estimate (committed offer): $6.8k / month for a 4x A100 reserved pool — equates to ~$0.136 / 1k tokens at expected 60% utilization (detailed calc in MAP_v2.1.pdf)

Action items & close timeline
- Redwood: Deliver final acceptance rubric (one-page) + committed pricing in DocuSign SOW — due 2026-09-04 (Owner: Tessa)
- LedgerAI: Internal procurement approval and signature — target 2026-09-10 (Owner: Sarah / Finance)
- Post-sign: Redwood to schedule production onboarding and a 2-week ramp plan — start by 2026-09-14 (Owner: Marcus)

Links: MAP_v2.1.pdf (attached), HubSpot deal HL-2026-0091, DocuSign: https://docusign.example/rwd/HL-2026-0091 (draft).

Please reply-all if any acceptance number looks off — Diego & Neha have full raw metrics in ledger_benchmark_results.csv if you want deeper granularity. If all good, we'll upload the one-page rubric to the SOW and route DocuSign.
